India and Japan strengthened their strategic partnership at the 16th Annual Summit in New Delhi, signing agreements on artificial intelligence, defence co-development, energy, critical minerals and economic security. The two leaders also highlighted growing Japanese investment, technology collaboration and shared Indo-Pacific goals.
